name: Securities Balance Type 6 Code
definition: Specifies the type of securities balance.

AVLB.name: Available
AVLB.definition: Balance of money or securities that is at the disposal of the account owner on the date specified.

REST.name: Restricted
REST.definition: Balance of cash that may only be used under certain conditions.||Balance type is used to block securities/cash in the client account e.g., in relation to elections relating to certain corporate actions. The holding is under the direct control of the system paying agent, who us the only one who can transfer securities out of this balance type.|Also known as the "escrow balance" or "sequestered balance".

TENT.name: Total Entitled
TENT.definition: Total quantity of financial instruments entitled to the account owner based on the terms of the corporate action event.

RDIS.name: Reserved For Distribution
RDIS.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are reserved for the distribution of the proceeds.

RREM.name: Reserved For Removal
RREM.definition: Balance of securities which are reserved temporarily in the SPA account before they will effectively be exchanged.
